title: Deploy Comms Bridge MCP Server to Cursor
spec:
DEPLOY THE COMMS BRIDGE MCP SERVER

Windsurf has reviewed and approved server.py. Now register it in Cursor's MCP config.

TASK 1: Add comms-bridge to ~/.cursor/mcp.json

Add this entry to the mcpServers object:

"comms-bridge": {
  "command": "python3",
  "args": [
    "/Users/michabr4/New Master Folder - Windsurf and Cursor/tools/agentic-starter-kit/mcp-servers/comms-bridge-mcp/server.py"
  ],
  "env": {
    "COMMS_DIR": "/Users/michabr4/New Master Folder - Windsurf and Cursor/.comms"
  }
}

TASK 2: Ensure dependencies are installed

cd ~/New\ Master\ Folder\ -\ Windsurf\ and\ Cursor/tools/agentic-starter-kit/mcp-servers/comms-bridge-mcp
If a .venv already exists from the build, verify mcp is installed:
  .venv/bin/pip list | grep mcp
If not, create one:
  python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

IMPORTANT: Update the mcp.json command to use the venv python:
"command": "/Users/michabr4/New Master Folder - Windsurf and Cursor/tools/agentic-starter-kit/mcp-servers/comms-bridge-mcp/.venv/bin/python3"

This ensures the MCP SDK is available when Cursor spawns the server.

TASK 3: Restart Cursor to reload MCP config

After updating mcp.json, Cursor needs to reload. Either:
- Restart Cursor entirely, OR
- Use Cmd+Shift+P → 'Reload Window'

TASK 4: Verify the MCP server is running

After restart, open a new chat and ask:
- 'Use the comms-bridge MCP to call get_pipeline_status'

Expected result: {"inbox": 0, "active": 0, "outbox": 0, "completed": N}
(where N is the number of completed tasks)

If it fails, check:
- Is the .venv python path correct in mcp.json?
- Does .venv/bin/pip list show mcp?
- Check Cursor's MCP logs for errors

TASK 5: Update .comms/transcript.md
Append: **[TIMESTAMP — CURSOR]** Comms Bridge MCP server deployed and verified. get_pipeline_status returned: [paste result]

Do NOT modify Windsurf's MCP config — Windsurf will handle its own deployment.
